inputs.name: evidenceObjectKey.reportId
inputs.description: The report ID that names the run folder in the evidence key; it must be 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and any other value throws 'Invalid report or asset ID'. Report IDs are created by reportState with randomUUID().

inputs.name: evidenceObjectKey.file
inputs.description: The evidence file name, which must be 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .png, .jpg, .webp, .wav, .mp3, .m4a or .ogg; any other value throws 'Invalid R2 evidence name'. reportAssets names image assets by the SHA-256 of their bytes plus the detected extension.

inputs.name: replayObjectKey.reportId
inputs.description: The report ID that names the run folder in the replay key; it must be 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and any other value throws 'Invalid report or asset ID'. Report IDs are created by reportState with randomUUID().

inputs.name: replayObjectKey.file
inputs.description: The replay file name, which must be 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .mp4; any other value throws 'Invalid R2 replay name'. Replay files are named by replayVideoKey, a SHA-256 hex digest, plus .mp4.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: The R2 settings: accountId, bucket, accessKeyId and secretAccessKey, plus an optional endpoint that replaces https://{accountId}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com when set. The constructor does not validate them, and fromEnvironment throws for a set endpoint that is not exactly http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.constructor.client
inputs.description: An optional S3Client the adapter uses as given; when it is omitted the constructor creates one with region auto, path-style addressing, and the endpoint and credentials from config.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.put.reportId
inputs.description: The report ID that names the run folder in the evidence key; it must be 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and any other value makes put reject with 'Invalid report or asset ID'. Report IDs are created by reportState with randomUUID().

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.put.file
inputs.description: The evidence file name, which must be 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .png, .jpg, .webp, .wav, .mp3, .m4a or .ogg; any other value makes put reject with 'Invalid R2 evidence name'. reportAssets names image assets by the SHA-256 of their bytes plus the detected extension.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.put.bytes
inputs.description: The file contents, written unchanged as the PutObject Body with no size check.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.put.mime
inputs.description: The MIME type sent as the object's ContentType; the adapter does not check it against the file extension, and EvidenceStorageService passes mediaMime(file).

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.get.reportId
inputs.description: The report ID that names the run folder in the evidence key; it must be 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and any other value makes get reject with 'Invalid report or asset ID'. Report IDs are created by reportState with randomUUID().

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.get.file
inputs.description: The evidence file name to read, which must be 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .png, .jpg, .webp, .wav, .mp3, .m4a or .ogg; any other value makes get reject with 'Invalid R2 evidence name'.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.putReplay.reportId
inputs.description: The report ID that names the run folder in the replay key; it must be 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and any other value makes putReplay reject with 'Invalid report or asset ID'. Report IDs are created by reportState with randomUUID().

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.putReplay.file
inputs.description: The replay file name, which must be 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .mp4; any other value makes putReplay reject with 'Invalid R2 replay name'. Replay files are named by replayVideoKey, a SHA-256 hex digest, plus .mp4.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.putReplay.bytes
inputs.description: The replay bytes, written unchanged as the PutObject Body; putReplay always sends ContentType video/mp4.

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.getReplay.reportId
inputs.description: The report ID that names the run folder in the replay key; it must be 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, and any other value makes getReplay reject with 'Invalid report or asset ID'. Report IDs are created by reportState with randomUUID().

inputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.getReplay.file
inputs.description: The replay file name to read, which must be 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .mp4; any other value makes getReplay reject with 'Invalid R2 replay name'.

outputs.name: evidenceObjectKey
outputs.description: The R2 object key for an evidence file, built as report-evidence/runs/{reportId}/assets/{file} from the checked reportId and file.

outputs.name: replayObjectKey
outputs.description: The R2 object key for a replay file, built as report-evidence/runs/{reportId}/replays/{file} from the checked reportId and file.

outputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.fromEnvironment
outputs.description: A new R2EvidenceStoreAdapter built from the R2 settings, or undefined when r2EvidenceConfig returns undefined, which happens only inside an isolated test store (PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME under tmpdir(), /tmp or /private/tmp) when PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE is local or all four R2 settings are empty.

outputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.put
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after the PutObject call succeeds; it rejects instead when the key check or the S3 call fails.

outputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.get
outputs.description: Resolves with the object's bytes as a Buffer copied from the response body; it rejects when the key check fails, the S3 call fails, or the response has no Body.

outputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.putReplay
outputs.description: Resolves with no value after the PutObject call succeeds with ContentType video/mp4; it rejects instead when the key check or the S3 call fails.

outputs.name: R2EvidenceStoreAdapter.getReplay
outputs.description: Resolves with the replay bytes as a Buffer copied from the response body; it rejects when the key check fails, the S3 call fails, or the response has no Body.

errors.name: R2EvidenceStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by evidenceObjectKey, with the message 'Invalid R2 evidence name', when file is not 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .png, .jpg, .webp, .wav, .mp3, .m4a or .ogg. put and get reject with the same error because they build the key inside async methods.

errors.name: R2EvidenceStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by replayObjectKey, with the message 'Invalid R2 replay name', when file is not 64 lowercase hex characters followed by .mp4. putReplay and getReplay reject with the same error.

errors.name: safeId failure (reportFiles)
errors.description: Thrown by safeId, with the message 'Invalid report or asset ID', when reportId is not 1 to 100 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. evidenceObjectKey and replayObjectKey reach it after their file check, so put, get, putReplay and getReplay reject with it too.

errors.name: R2EvidenceStoreError
errors.description: Thrown by read, with the message 'R2 evidence has no body', when the GetObjectCommand response has no Body. get and getReplay reject with it.

errors.name: Local report storage requires an isolated test store
errors.description: Thrown by r2EvidenceConfig, and so by fromEnvironment, with the message 'Local-only storage is restricted to temporary test stores; real report media requires Cloudflare R2', when PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE is local and PROJECT_REPORTS_HOME is not under tmpdir(), /tmp or /private/tmp.

errors.name: r2EvidenceConfig failure (Reports config)
errors.description: Thrown by r2EvidenceConfig, and so by fromEnvironment, with the message 'Cloudflare R2 evidence storage is partially configured; real reports require all four R2 settings', when any of accountId, bucket, accessKeyId or secretAccessKey is empty, unless all four are empty inside an isolated test store.

errors.name: r2EvidenceConfig failure (Reports config)
errors.description: Thrown by r2EvidenceConfig, and so by fromEnvironment, with the message 'R2 endpoint override must be a local test server', when PROJECT_REPORTS_R2_ENDPOINT is non-empty and is not exactly http://127.0.0.1 followed by a port.

errors.name: Report storage settings file read failure
errors.description: When PROJECT_REPORTS_ASSET_STORAGE is not local, NODE_ENV is not test and PROJECT_REPORTS_CONFIG_FILE is set, a file-system error other than ENOENT (such as EACCES) raised while reading that file is rethrown unchanged by readLocalR2Config and reaches fromEnvironment through r2EvidenceConfig.

errors.name: S3Client.send or response-body transform failure (@aws-sdk/client-s3)
errors.description: Failures from the S3 client, such as network or service errors from send or from reading the response body, are not caught by the adapter, so callers receive them unchanged.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown as a TypeError when config is null or undefined and client is null or undefined, because the constructor reads config.endpoint while building the S3Client options; when client is set, config is not read and this error cannot occur.
